title: Upgrade
description: Moves each plain version a central package file pins to the newest listed release its consumers' frameworks, hosts, and repository partners accept, then restores its projects with dotnet restore --force-evaluate

central.description: Central package file (Directory.Packages.props) whose PackageVersion and GlobalPackageReference versions move

projects.description: Project files reading the central file, their lock files and hosts deciding each move, restored in one NuGet graph after it

args.description: Arguments after -- appended to the restore
